method: Manually reviewed twenty complete roots, baseline/current raw declaration bounds and reached fixture/production paths. Metadata-only serialization/hash over explicit manually reviewed spans; no source parser/scanner or project execution.

classification_definitions.integration: Genuine project service/API/network/process/store/runtime boundary materially supports asserted observable behavior.
classification_definitions.unit: Local predicates/parsing/time or fake callbacks; incidental filesystem setup/logging does not qualify.
classification_definitions.mixed: Independent local-only assertion blocks coexist with genuine boundary assertions.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Source/mapping contradiction or missing evidence leaves intended assertions uncredited; separate from runtime UNKNOWN.

	l := nativeLab(t)
	rule := ntpRule("ts-orch-fc-ntp-owned", "198.19.7.1")

}
